title: Simple and effective
body: Easy to use, straightforward. Been using it for over 4/5 years. Very happy with it.
author: jalexsm

title: A daily productivity app
body: A great app to track your routine. Very easy to set up and intuitive. Been using it for years without missing a day. Well done team
author: AshmathA

title: Still first day!
body: First day of using it but I am already so in love with everything about it till the degree I am coming here to write something!! While I usually avoid writing reviews. Been searching for a while for an app to track habits and couldn’t find something really simple useful and not expensive. Thanks to developer/developers!!
author: the.Nad1a

title: Track your goals!
body: An excellent app. I've always had a problem with consistency when it comes to life goals and This app has really helped me stay on track as well as giving me a visual representation of how I'm doing with my goals and tasks on a daily basis.
author: Bing Ratnapala

title: Simple and effective
body: I love this app. Just set your habit goals, turn on notifications and update it daily. I have been using it for a few months now and it's awesome!
author: SumKhub

title: Way of life
body: This app has changed my life a lot and made me a better person and broke a lot of bad habits that im always depressed if i dont tick one of the activities on my journals or if i break a streak but that motivates me to do better next time its a great and amazing that I think everyone should try
author: Taha khader

title: Loved it :)
body: I like the fact that it reminds me of habits I need to stick on to, avoid, be consistent at .. Also to keep my track record good with my habits , I'm forced to stick onto what i have taken on and keep at it .. Daily ticking it yes or no does create pressure and I kinda like that ..
